category.name: Fonts
category.preferred_workflow: Use Aspose.Words font APIs exclusively for document text formatting, qualify ambiguous types with their full namespace, apply formatting through Run.Font, Style.Font, ParagraphFormat, or DocumentBuilder.Font, and verify each change before saving the document.

strict_api_bans: Do not import System.Drawing in this category; use Aspose.Drawing only when a drawing-specific color is required.
Never reference bare Font or Color types without disambiguation when both Aspose.Words and Aspose.Drawing define them.
canonical_patterns: Apply text formatting through Run.Font, Style.Font, ParagraphFormat, or DocumentBuilder.Font, never through Aspose.Drawing.Font.
Convert Aspose.Drawing.Color to System.Drawing.Color before assigning it to Font.Color or Font.Fill.Color.
Create local sample documents, apply formatting, and validate the properties before persisting the file.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate that objects such as Document, Paragraph, and Run are instantiated before accessing their Font members to avoid null-reference warnings.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails because UnderlineType is not defined in Aspose.Words.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references a non-existent UnderlineType enum instead of the correct Aspose.Words.Underline enum.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace UnderlineType with Aspose.Words.Underline and assign values such as Underline.Single or Underline.WavyDouble.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words API reference for the exact enum name and use IntelliSense to select the correct member.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The compiler reports that Font.LineSpacing is read-only and cannot be assigned.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Line spacing is a paragraph-level attribute, not a font attribute.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Set ParagraphFormat.LineSpacingRule to Multiple and ParagraphFormat.LineSpacing to the desired multiplier (e.g., 1.5 or 2.0).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Apply line-spacing changes through ParagraphFormat rather than Font, and reset to default by assigning 0 to ParagraphFormat.LineSpacing.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails because EmphasisMark does not contain a member named Dot.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The Aspose.Words.Fonts.EmphasisMark enum does not define a Dot value; the closest supported value is OverSolidCircle.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use EmphasisMark.OverSolidCircle (or another valid member) from Aspose.Words.Fonts.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the Aspose.Words.Fonts namespace and verify available enum members before coding.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails due to missing members such as FontSubstitutionSettings.FontSubstitutes or DefaultFontName.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code uses outdated or non-existent properties of FontSettings; the current API exposes FontSettings.SubstitutionSettings.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Review the latest Aspose.Words documentation for FontSettings and use the SubstitutionSettings property for custom mappings.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation errors arise from implicit conversion between Aspose.Drawing.Color and System.Drawing.Color.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Font.Color and Font.Fill.Color expect System.Drawing.Color, while sample code creates Aspose.Drawing.Color objects.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always create the final color value as System.Drawing.Color before assigning it to Font properties.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0138 errors indicate that a using directive targets a type rather than a namespace.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to write "using Font;" or "using Style;" instead of proper namespace imports.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove type-level using statements; import only namespaces such as Aspose.Words, Aspose.Words.Fonts, or use fully qualified type names.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Limit using directives to namespaces and rely on fully qualified names when type name collisions exist.

narrative.overview: The Fonts category demonstrates how to manipulate text appearance in Aspose.Words documents using the library's Font, Style, and DocumentBuilder APIs. Verified examples show correct handling of font properties, underline styles, line spacing, emphasis marks, and color conversion while avoiding common ambiguities.
narrative.purpose: Provide concise, reproducible code snippets that illustrate proper font manipulation in Aspose.Words, enabling AI agents to generate reliable examples that compile, run, and validate the intended visual changes.
validation_priorities: Always assert that the expected Font property (e.g., Underline, LineSpacingRule, EmphasisMark) matches the value set before saving the document.
maintenance_notes: Update examples when new Aspose.Words versions introduce renamed enums or additional font-related properties.
